Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Intetics Inc. , a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and "all-things-digital" solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior PHP Engineer to join our dynamic team.
The client is a leading company specializing in advanced cybersecurity solutions. They provide comprehensive security measures designed to protect sensitive data and systems from cyber threats. Their offerings include vulnerability management, threat intelligence, incident response, and compliance management. With cutting-edge technology and a team of experts, they ensure robust protection for organizations across various industries, helping clients stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and maintain a secure digital environment.
 Responsibilities
Take end-to-end ownership of QA for a new .NET-based product as the sole QA engineer
Define and implement the testing strategy, test plans, quality standards, and release readiness criteria
Select appropriate automation tools and build a maintainable test automation framework from scratch
Design, implement, and maintain automated tests covering critical functionality, integrations, and end-to-end workflows
Perform manual and exploratory testing to validate new features and identify issues beyond automated coverage
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and ensure reliable, actionable test results
Collaborate with developers and product stakeholders to clarify requirements, identify edge cases, and improve testability early in development
Investigate defects, document reproducible findings, and verify fixes
Drive release quality by assessing test coverage, communicating risks, and providing clear release readiness recommendations
 Requirements
Proven experience in a Senior QA or QA Automation role, with the ability to independently own the full QA lifecycle
Experience establishing QA processes and building test automation frameworks from scratch
Strong hands-on programming skills in at least one language used for test automation; no specific language is required
Solid understanding of test design techniques, risk-based testing, and selecting appropriate levels of test coverage
Experience testing APIs, backend services, and integrations
Ability to combine automated, manual, and exploratory testing effectively
Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and working with Git
Strong troubleshooting skills, including working with logs, test data, and databases
Ability to select tools pragmatically, prioritize testing activities, and work independently in a new project with evolving requirements
Clear communication skills and the ability to explain quality risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Nice to Have
Experience testing .NET-based applications or programming in C#
Previous experience as the sole QA engineer on a product
Experience with performance, load, or security testing
Experience with containerized test environments and Docker
